mentions.name: SF Sunset Alerts
mentions.description: This website predicts when San Francisco sunsets will be particularly outstanding and sends alerts accordingly. Predictions are LLM-powered to more reliably consume the free-text descriptions of predicted high and low cloud cover around sunset in traditional weather forecasts (e.g., NWS). The page displays the prediction and also shows the current view from several cameras around the city.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the past few weeks, I cobbled together a system of alerts for when the sunset is predicted [1] to be particularly outstanding, resulting in this page that displays the prediction and also shows the current view from several cameras around the city.
mentions.author: vtjeng
